notes.title: Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is Out Now! ⚔️
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43217845/f92a4d80d0acad119963abf1a4d58e667ddacae0.jpg[/img]

Greetings friends!!!
We have some great news to share with you today.

[b]Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona is now available on Steam! We are offering a special 15% discount during the launch period.[/b]
The game is also available on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2139840/Skelethrone_The_Chronicles_of_Ericona/

At its core this is a Souls-like game that features Metroidvania elements, filled with exploration and secrets to be found.

You're in for a great adventure inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Bloodthirsty monsters, divine creatures and epic boss battles. The game’s story is shaped by choices that will define your journey.

[h3]Let's celebrate the game's launch![/h3]
In honor of the release, please watch the trailer and immerse yourself in the world of Makh-Abyss before fully exploring the story and finding out what actually happened after the death of Lord Derek Ericona.

[previewyoutube=PtAhNjGXCuY;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Welcome to the Eastern Front!
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/htn6PYbXDpI
Comrades!
Interested in WW2 or card gaming?

Then you are in luck, because we have just the perfect game for you! And it's free too!

About Card Blitz: WWII

WWII card game - simple but deep, challenging but friendly. If you are into military history, collecting, and fast game sessions then Card Blitz is perfect for you! Dive into the harsh world of ruthless and historical card battles! Collect troops and trophies. Gather legendary generals under your command!

[list]
[*] Over 150 cards: tanks, infantry, aircraft, artillery, support units, and generals!
[*] Welcome history figures to your army: Rommel and Rokossovsky are yours to command!
[*] Fight against other players and earn well-deserved trophies!
[*] Learn, adapt, collect, and build the legendary deck!
[/list]

Join the fight now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1264220/Card_Blitz_WWII/

notes.title: We resumed work on the game!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/458030/StarFringe_Adversus/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34020822/2f3fa61431a4550cd56492c38e419649ed6cb5c2.jpg[/img][/url]

We welcome all fans of space strategy, and especially those players who are still waiting for this game to be released in its final form. Thank you all for your patience.
This game has changed publisher, and we are pleased to announce that we have resumed development.
So far I can not tell you exactly what will happen and when, because we have not fully appreciated the remaining assets and what needs to be done to complete the project. In general, this will be our first task.
Follow the news, we will try to write them regularly.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/458030/StarFringe_Adversus/

notes.title: News for the past April
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34020822/11bc9a5e15b97381a914283ec0ed68bf7f4590cc.png[/img]

The first news is what you see on the cover of this post. We have added trading cards to the BlackSoul game. But more than that, we reduced the price to its minimum. In our opinion, this game is worthy of the attention of the horror genre fans. Buy it, play and write honest reviews! ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/264480/BlackSoul_Extended_Edition/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34020822/0e1c105f3382050953d5d8f41e3d5b307621a422.jpg[/img]

The second news is the appearance among our games of an excellent space simulation strategy game StellarHub. Almost all of our team played this game for several days and it was really exciting. Build a space base, mine resources, manage personnel, defend the base from enemies. Very, very addictive game. In general, we are happy to present it to you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/672860/StellarHub/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34020822/ecb32d2ea7a117d1dd69f54cebeb59aba2a4b642.jpg[/img]

The third news is that we are preparing to release a cute platformer about Bunny and Little Fox. This is a story about friendship, loyalty and mutual aid. Very good fairy tale. The game will be released in May, in the near future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1075790/Fox_and_Bunny/

notes.title: Fishermurs - be a lemur!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34020822/d4989eda715df7771a0f859615772c27d0fb33a5.jpg[/img]

A new great game has appeared in our collection. Fishermurs is a fun arcade game about unusual lemurs who love fish very much!
You expect fun battles on inflatable boats, different types of weapons, dangerous inhabitants of the ocean and a lot of humor!
Play against friends of the network or one against bots, hone the skill of hunting fish ;) And most importantly - have fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/564210/Fishermurs/

notes.title: Release
notes.content:
Hi there!
 We are made a great work during last month. Added some new modes, a lot of new maps. And localization. Now we have english and russian languages! (in plans - make turkish language too!).
 
 We decided to go to RELEASE in next week! So, baloons, fireworks and good DISCOUNT will be waiting for you ;)

Cheers!
